gap_rows.title: rwb-integration booking confirmation (app slice): JOB-08 ownership and event consumer lists, the ACE read boundary, the consumed paths and shapes, the login, the package values and the MSG-P1-001 wording are not settled by one source
gap_rows.source: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13, 16, 41, 42, 43, 44 and 45; Recovery Workbench Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 15, 16 and 18; TSD P2 Integration v3 T3.1, T5.2 and Appendix T-A; FSD P2 Integration v3 A1.1, A1.5 and VR-P2-001-1; Ownership Map tables interface_config, outbound_item, job_catalog, decision_record library, and API rows GET /data-products/freshness, POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun (owner P1) and GET /treatments/{treatmentId} (owner S2); legacy RWB-E2-007 sections 3, 4, 5, 7, 11, 12, 13, 14 and 16; Template and Rules v1 R3, R5.5, R5.7 and R9
gap_rows.section: 3 Preconditions, 4 Flow, 5 Exception paths, 6 INVEST check, 9 State transitions, 10 Authority, 11 Data, 12.1 to 12.9, 13 Solution plan, 14 Validation and messages, 16 Test cases
gap_rows.description: One combined row for the app slice of this key. (1) Job ownership: Architecture v5 slide 44 names rwb-payment the owner of JOB-08 Booking confirmation and slides 42 and 43 list rwb-payment, not rwb-integration, among the consumers of AceDataReady (EV-26) and TreatmentApproved (EV-10); RWB-P4-E2007-APP and RWB-ITG-E2007-ITG both state that JOB-08 and its activities belong to RWB-P2-E2007-APP, and this story follows that accepted split. (2) ACE read boundary: TSD P2 Integration v3 T5.2 says P2 reads the recovery.v_ace_* views directly and calls nothing in P1 for inbound data, while ADR-010, DP-05 and Architecture v5 slides 41 and 45 make rwb-source-data the only reader of the views and ACE data; the account facts, the batch-completeness answer and the REC-03 write therefore go through the rwb-source-data contract and rwb_integration holds no grant on recovery. (3) Consumed paths and shapes: the legacy story calls the Java interfaces TreatmentQuery.approvedNotBooked, TreatmentCommands.markBooked, TreatmentCommands.recordBookingDifference, AccountQuery.forCase, BatchStatusQuery.forSource, RuleEvaluator.evaluate, TaskApi.raiseTask and the reconciliation writer; no source fixes an HTTP path, a JSON field name or an error for the treatment list, the mark-booked write, the difference write, the case-account read, the reconciliation write or the case task raise, and the treatment single read is the only one with an Ownership Map row. (4) Rerun: the legacy story names POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun; the Ownership Map and API Specification v4 keep that path with x-module P1 as the generic job-catalogue rerun, while this realignment makes JOB-08 a rwb-integration job whose rerun only this service can perform. (5) Login: no source names the per-service login of rwb-integration under DP-02. (6) Package values: package BOOKING_MATCH version BKG-2026.12, its RESTRUCTURE and SETTLEMENT rows and the tolerance 0.00 baht are legacy values of the story master and RWB-E2-042; the row identifiers of the package are the registry's and no source names them in this story, so no rule row ID is written in the criteria. (7) Message text: MSG-P1-001 has two wordings in the sources and FSD P2 Integration v3 gives the current one. (8) Data lake: the legacy REC-03 wording and the legacy section 13 mention reconciliation_result only; DP-17 removes the data lake and nothing in this key builds or sends a lake file.
gap_rows.evidence: Architecture v5 slide 44 lists 'JOB-08 | Booking confirmation | Airflow: ACE data ready | rwb-payment | event-triggered workflow'; slides 42 and 43 give the consumer lists of EV-26 and EV-10 without rwb-integration; TSD P2 Integration v3 T5.2 states that P2 reads the views in T1.1 directly; ADR-010 and DP-05 make rwb-source-data the only ACE reader and Architecture v5 slides 41 and 45 repeat it; the legacy RWB-E2-007 section 12 publishes Java interfaces with one HTTP path only; the Ownership Map API row POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun reads owner P1 while job_catalog reads owner P2; the legacy MSG-P1-001 text is 'Today's load has not arrived.' and FSD P2 Integration v3 VR-P2-001-1 gives 'Today's data is not yet complete.'
gap_rows.area: Contract, ownership, ACE read boundary, scheduling, messages
gap_rows.owner_role: Solution architect; contract owners of rwb-treatment, rwb-source-data, rwb-case and rwb-decision; ACE team and DBA
gap_rows.proposed: Keep JOB-08 and its activities with rwb-integration as the sibling stories state and record the rwb-payment owner row of Architecture v5 slide 44 as superseded for this job; read every ACE fact through the rwb-source-data contract and record TSD P2 v3 T5.2 as superseded; fix the six unsettled consumed paths and shapes in RWB-P2-E2007-CON with their owners; serve the rerun on the integration base for the jobs of this service's catalogue; allocate the rwb-integration login in RWB-PLT-DB; keep the BOOKING_MATCH values unchanged and the row identifiers in the registry; take the FSD P2 Integration v3 wording of MSG-P1-001; and confirm that no lake artefact is built for REC-03.

asm_rows.text: rwb-integration runs as its own ACE database login with grants on its own schema rwb_integration only (DP-02), replacing the shared recovery service identity of the legacy story, and the booking-confirmation workflow, its activities and its rerun all run under that one login carried by the chart as a secret reference.
asm_rows.why: No source document names the per-service login, while DP-02 requires one login per service and Architecture v5 slides 16 and 41 give rwb-integration its own schema, topic and task queue.
asm_rows.read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 16 and 41; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-02; Ownership Map schema row rwb_integration; legacy RWB-E2-007 sections 10 and 13 (the recovery service identity).
asm_rows.applied_in: 3 Preconditions, 10 Authority and 13 Solution plan of RWB-P2-E2007-APP
asm_rows.confirm: ACE team and DBA (schema and login provisioning, RWB-PLT-DB)
asm_rows.impact: The story builds and tests against the rwb-integration login once it is allocated; no behaviour of the match changes.

asm_rows.text: JOB-08 Booking confirmation and its activities belong to rwb-integration in this realignment, as RWB-P4-E2007-APP and RWB-ITG-E2007-ITG both state, and the job is an event-started workflow on AceDataReady with no Schedule; the Architecture v5 slide 44 row that names rwb-payment as its owner is recorded as superseded for this job.
asm_rows.why: Two sources disagree: Architecture v5 slide 44 names rwb-payment the owner of JOB-08 and slides 42 and 43 do not list rwb-integration among the consumers of AceDataReady or TreatmentApproved, while the accepted split of this legacy key places the match in rwb-integration.
asm_rows.read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 42, 43 and 44; RWB-P4-E2007-APP section 1; RWB-ITG-E2007-ITG sections 1, 12.5 and 19; RWB-P3-E2007-APP section 12.6; Template and Rules v1 R3 and R5.5 DP-10.

asm_rows.confirm: Solution architect owns the ruling; platform workflow kit owner and the rwb-payment owner accept it
asm_rows.impact: The workflow runs on the rwb-integration queue and the job catalogue row is written there; no Schedule is created and the rwb-payment slice of JOB-08 is not built.

asm_rows.text: Only rwb-source-data reads the recovery.v_ace_* views and ACE data; the accounts and their booked terms, the ALS batch-completeness answer and the REC-03 write of this key all go through the rwb-source-data contract, TSD P2 Integration v3 T5.2 is superseded on its direct-read sentence, and rwb_integration holds no grant on recovery and no view of its own.
asm_rows.why: ADR-010, DP-05 and Architecture v5 slides 41 and 45 make rwb-source-data the only reader of the ACE views, while TSD P2 Integration v3 T5.2 states that P2 reads the views in T1.1 directly; the higher source wins and the loser is recorded.
asm_rows.read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8, 9, 13, 29, 37, 41 and 45; ADR-010; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-05; TSD P2 Integration v3 T5.2; FSD P2 Integration v3 A1.1 and A1.4.

asm_rows.confirm: Solution architect; the rwb-source-data and rwb-integration owners; ACE team
asm_rows.impact: The match reads the ACE facts through a contract with a 2 s budget instead of a view; the ACE team grants no SELECT on recovery to rwb_integration.

asm_rows.text: The six consumed calls that no source gives an HTTP path or a JSON shape — the approved-not-booked treatment list, the mark-booked write, the booking-difference write, the case-account read at a business date, the REC-03 reconciliation write and the rwb-case task raise — carry the placeholder in the story and are taken from RWB-P3-E2004-CON, RWB-P1-E2007-APP and the rwb-case contract when they are published; the rerun of a job in this service's catalogue is served on the integration base at POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun.
asm_rows.why: The legacy story names these calls as Java interfaces only, and the generic rerun of the job catalogue is kept with P1 in API Specification v4 and the Ownership Map while a rwb-integration job can only be rerun by rwb-integration.
asm_rows.read: Legacy RWB-E2-007 sections 12 and 13; Ownership Map API rows POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun (owner P1) and GET /admin/scheduled-jobs (owner P2); TSD P2 Integration v3 Appendix T-A API-P2-009; RWB-P2-E2007-CON section 12.2.
asm_rows.confirm: Contract owners of rwb-treatment, rwb-source-data and rwb-case; solution architect for the rerun placement
asm_rows.impact: The paths and field names are confirmed or corrected in the owning contract baselines; the workflow and its fakes follow the correction without a behaviour change.

asm_rows.text: MSG-P1-001 uses the FSD P2 Integration v3 wording '{product} is from {date}. Today's data is not yet complete.' in place of the legacy 'Today's load has not arrived.', and every other message of this key keeps its legacy or platform text unchanged.
asm_rows.why: The legacy story carries one wording and the current FSD carries the reworded text after D-RCV-35; the FSD is the higher source for a message text and the change is recorded rather than silent.
asm_rows.read: FSD P2 Integration v3 VR-P2-001-1 and the version 3 change note; legacy RWB-E2-007 section 14; Template and Rules v1 R3 and R7.3.
asm_rows.confirm: Platform message catalogue owner; business analyst of P2
asm_rows.impact: Only the batch-gate message text changes; no test value and no scenario changes.

asm_rows.text: Package BOOKING_MATCH, its version BKG-2026.12, its RESTRUCTURE and SETTLEMENT rows and the tolerance of 0.00 baht are kept as the legacy values of this key, and the row identifiers of the package stay in the rwb-decision registry and are named by no source of this story, so the criteria cite the outcome and the version only.
asm_rows.why: The legacy values are fixed by D-RCV-36 and the story master, the registry rows are rwb-decision's, and inventing a row identifier would breach the rule that no value is invented.
